description.value: Bubble Waffle Cafe brings Hong Kong street-snack culture to the Vancouver area, serving its namesake egg waffles (雞蛋仔), curry fish balls, rice noodle rolls, and fish soup noodle combos with an expansive array of Taiwanese-style milk teas and fruit drinks. The cafe operates across multiple Metro Vancouver locations including Aberdeen Centre, the Public Market, and Park Royal. It is a quick-service counter-style spot ideal for a fuelling stop mid-ride.
